inputs.Title: RegistrySchemaVersion
inputs.ConfigDescription: Current DGO HTTP flow registry contract version.

inputs.Title: StaleAfterDays
inputs.ConfigDescription: Days without registration or execution activity before an active flow is stale.

inputs.Title: ExecutionRetentionDays
inputs.ConfigDescription: Approved retention period for execution-ledger records.

inputs.Title: ConsecutiveFailureThreshold
inputs.ConfigDescription: Consecutive failures required before creating a governance exception.

inputs.Title: GovernanceNotificationEmail
inputs.ConfigDescription: Mailbox for registry, exception and provisioning notifications.

inputs.Title: CaptureRequestBody
inputs.ConfigDescription: Raw HTTP request-body capture is disabled.

inputs.Title: CaptureHeaders
inputs.ConfigDescription: Raw HTTP header capture is disabled.

inputs.Title: CaptureQueries
inputs.ConfigDescription: Sanitized query metadata may be captured.

inputs.Title: ProvisioningSchemaExpectedListCount
inputs.ConfigDescription: Expected number of registry SharePoint lists.

inputs.Title: ProvisioningSchemaExpectedFieldCount
inputs.ConfigDescription: Expected number of custom registry fields.

inputs.where: @contains(createArray('Active HTTP Flows','Noncompliant Flows','Critical Flows','Retired Flows','Open Exceptions','Recent Failures','Unapproved Consumers'),item()?['Title'])

inputs.reportType: DGO HTTP Flow Registry Complete Provisioning Report
